purpose: Govern personal-work keyword and LunaRunes analysis without changing existing statistics copy or public ranking presentation.

deferred: Threads corpus unless explicitly promoted into a later scan

statistics_governance.song_count_definition: Count actual song/version identities. Multiple song_ids using the same lyrics count as multiple songs.
statistics_governance.unique_lyrics_count_definition: Count unique full lyric texts only once. Use lyrics_hash or equivalent normalized full-text identity rather than title.
statistics_governance.unique_lyrics_character_count_definition: Count characters from deduplicated full lyric texts only once; do not multiply character counts when several songs share one lyric text.

classification_governance.rule: Groups 1-8 are general semantic classifications. Group 9 / 德 is lo3rwang's author-specific work classification and must not be generalized as universal LunaRunes semantics.

author_owned_terms.notes: Author-owned named concept. Do not split into 福、月、明 or other extended meanings. Semantic intent remains direct light semantics when that dimension is analyzed.
Author-owned named concept. Do not decompose by characters for classification.
Author-specific governance vocabulary in lo3rwang scope; does not redefine the universal semantics of other scopes.

direct_semantic_rules: 微光 belongs to 光 as a form of light.
微月光 has direct light semantic intent; extended associations such as 福、希望、塵、明 are not inferred from that phrase alone.
Do not map by character appearance alone.
Do not continue along chains of inferred consequences. Classify the direct meaning being expressed.
When a recurring misclassification appears, review and improve the governing principle instead of accumulating one-off exceptions.
Author-owned lexical classification and semantic intent are separate dimensions.

simple_semantic_engine.name: basic_rune_semantic_engine
simple_semantic_engine.method: Compare the work or expression directly against governed rune principles and allow limited oscillation only among genuinely adjacent direct meanings.
principles: No automatic mapping from a possible consequence back to the original expression.
Use governed rune ownership and exclusions.
Prefer principle correction over exception accumulation.
Keep author classification separate from semantic intent.

boundary_examples.expression: 遲到／延誤／錯過適合時機

api_semantic_engine.role: Independent semantic observer for keyword/theme/rune candidates.

cross_validation.rule: Disagreement is governance evidence. It must not automatically change Canon or produce a one-off patch.
cross_validation.review_goal: Reduce recurring disputes by improving principles, not by adding endless exceptions.

scan_order: compare basic engine with API semantic engine
rerun the same corpus for comparison
